name: code-ontology-companion
description: Reverse-engineer authorized code into privacy-conscious local ontologies with deterministic analysis and portable RDF.

interface.shortDescription: Local code graphs with RDF lineage
interface.longDescription: Statically map an authorized Java, Spring, or Python repository into immutable local knowledge-graph snapshots. Search symbols through a read-only local MCP server, inspect possible change impact, compare versions, preserve evidence lineage, export RDF 1.1 Turtle, and open a self-contained offline workbench. Deterministic analysis executes no target code and makes no network request. If existing Ollama is detected, the user may separately authorize bounded loopback-only inference that remains unvalidated and separate from the observed graph. The plugin never installs a model or starts Ollama; authorized enrichment runs the selected model and requests immediate unload after the response.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this authorized repository and propose how to reverse-engineer it into a safe local ontology workspace.
Configure or use the optional read-only local MCP server, then check my registered ontology workspace freshness.
After explaining the Ollama data boundary, inspect existing local models for this initialized workspace with my consent.
